sdg_name: Strengthen the means of implementation and revitalize the Global Partnership for Sustainable Development
contribution: When assigned to SDG monitoring or public-interest programmes, a data analyst can turn relevant datasets into findings that help organizations track needs and inform decisions; the job alone does not guarantee SDG progress.
evidence_note: Official UN target 17.18 calls for high-quality, timely and reliable disaggregated data. This establishes a data-capacity need; connecting a particular analyst role to that target is an inference and depends on the work supporting SDG measurement or implementation.

sdg_name: Strengthen the means of implementation and revitalize the Global Partnership for Sustainable Development
contribution: For SDG reporting or related public-interest work, a data engineer can build dependable pipelines that make relevant data more timely and usable; the contribution depends on the datasets, governance and actual use.
evidence_note: Official UN target 17.18 calls for high-quality, timely and reliable disaggregated data. The target supports the need for dependable data systems, but does not identify data engineering as an occupation; this role-to-target link is conditional inference.

sdg_name: Build resilient infrastructure, promote inclusive and sustainable industrialization and foster innovation
contribution: When building a digital public service or another service aligned with development needs, a back-end engineer can implement reliable server-side systems and integrations that help the service operate; the outcome depends on the service and its users.
evidence_note: The ITU–UNDP agenda identifies digital public infrastructure, applications and services as technical enablers of SDG progress. It does not attribute those outcomes to back-end engineers; applying the role description to that pathway is an inference.

sdg_name: Build resilient infrastructure, promote inclusive and sustainable industrialization and foster innovation
contribution: By implementing a usable interface for a digital service that addresses a development need, a front-end engineer can help people reach and use that service; the contribution depends on the service being valuable, accessible and available to its intended users.
evidence_note: The ITU–UNDP agenda describes digital applications and services as potential enablers of SDG progress. It does not establish an impact for front-end engineering as an occupation; the link is conditional on the service and implementation.

sdg_name: Reduce inequality within and among countries
contribution: When research and testing include people with disabilities and other users who face access barriers, a UX designer can identify and reduce barriers in digital journeys, supporting more inclusive access to services.
evidence_note: W3C explains that accessibility, usability and inclusion overlap, and that usability practice often does not sufficiently address people with disabilities. The SDG 10 link depends on deliberately including under-served users and addressing barriers; ordinary UX work may not do so.

sdg_name: Reduce inequality within and among countries
contribution: By designing interface screens with accessibility requirements in mind, a UI designer can help reduce digital barriers so people with disabilities can perceive, navigate and use online information and services.
evidence_note: W3C states that accessible websites and tools enable people with disabilities to use the Web and support equal access and opportunity. Accessibility is named in this role’s supplied duties, so the occupational pathway is direct; whether a particular interface achieves inclusion still requires implementation and testing.

sdg_name: Build resilient infrastructure, promote inclusive and sustainable industrialization and foster innovation
contribution: When monitoring and response work protects critical digital infrastructure, a security analyst can help maintain the reliability and security of systems that organizations and communities depend on.
evidence_note: ITU says cybersecurity and protection of critical infrastructure are important for social and economic development and identifies a particular connection to SDG 9. The occupation link is conditional: the role must help protect relevant infrastructure, not merely perform generic security administration.

sdg_name: Promote sustained, inclusive and sustainable economic growth, full and productive employment and decent work for all
contribution: For a Malaysian small business, effective digital campaigns can improve customer reach and help the business develop its market; any contribution to inclusive economic growth depends on the business outcomes and who benefits.
evidence_note: Malaysia’s Digital Economy Blueprint identifies digital marketing as a way to strengthen business connection and engagement with customers and links business digital adoption to productivity ambitions. It does not show that a marketing role itself causes growth or decent work; that relationship is inferred and conditional.

sdg_name: Promote sustained, inclusive and sustainable economic growth, full and productive employment and decent work for all
contribution: For a small enterprise, improving search discoverability can help prospective customers find its products or services and may support market access; the SDG contribution depends on the enterprise’s results and practices.
evidence_note: The OECD’s 2025 D4SME survey reports that retail businesses prioritize digital marketing and SEO and frames digitalisation as a route to SME competitiveness and market access. Its survey covers ten OECD countries, not Malaysia, and does not prove SEO work causes SDG 8 outcomes; this is a conditional pathway.

sdg_name: Build resilient infrastructure, promote inclusive and sustainable industrialization and foster innovation
contribution: When machine-learning work is responsibly applied to a defined development or industrial need, an AI/ML engineer can help develop and test an innovation that supports that need; the benefit depends on the use case, safeguards and who can access it.
evidence_note: The ITU–UNDP agenda describes digital technologies as potential accelerators of SDG progress and stresses safe, responsible and equitable deployment. It does not establish that AI/ML jobs inherently advance SDG 9; the connection is conditional on the application and outcomes.

sdg_name: Promote sustained, inclusive and sustainable economic growth, full and productive employment and decent work for all
contribution: When supporting responsibly designed products that expand fair access to useful financial services, a fintech analyst can use transaction and product evidence to inform improvements; the impact depends on the product, safeguards and customers served.
evidence_note: Bank Negara Malaysia’s Financial Inclusion Framework describes access to affordable financial products as supporting household, business and economic resilience, and says financial inclusion enables progress on SDGs. It supports the sector pathway, not a causal impact for fintech analysts; the connection depends on inclusive product outcomes.
